address: # RSCFD / RSCAN-FD register bases used by Can transport (docs/CAN_TRANSPORT_ANALYSIS.md).
# Channel-0 bases match the firmware peripheral table at 0x23000; channel-1
# (application CAN1) and diagnostic Tx buffer n=16 are labeled explicitly.

name: CFSTS
comment: RSCFD common-FIFO status base (ch0/fifo0; +0x0C*ch +4*fifo)

name: CFSTS_CH1
comment: RSCFD common-FIFO status for application CAN1 (ch1/fifo0)

name: CFPCTR
comment: RSCFD common-FIFO pointer control base (write 0xFF advances)

name: CFPCTR_CH1
comment: RSCFD common-FIFO pointer control for application CAN1

name: CFDTMC
comment: RSCFD Tx message-buffer control base (CFDTMCn.TMTR at +n)

name: CFDTMC16
comment: Diagnostic Tx buffer control (HTH 0x13 -> n=16; TMTR bit 0)

name: CFDTMSTS
comment: RSCFD Tx message-buffer status base (CFDTMSTSn at +n)

name: CFDTMSTS_CH1
comment: RSCFD Tx status base for application CAN1 record

name: CFID
comment: RSCFD common-FIFO message RAM base (CFID/CFPTR/CFDF window)

name: CFID_CH1
comment: RSCFD common-FIFO message RAM for application CAN1

name: CFDTMID
comment: RSCFD Tx message-buffer RAM base (0x20-byte entries)

name: CFDTMID16
comment: Diagnostic Tx message RAM for buffer n=16 (CAN 0x7A9 path)

address: # ICUSCMD encoding is verified; companion offsets use firmware-observed roles.

name: ICUSCMD
comment: ICU-S command register; CMAC verify writes (key_slot<<16)|7

name: ICUSDAT
comment: ICU-S data/parameter word written beside ICUSCMD (firmware role)

name: ICUSSTS
comment: ICU-S status; driver polls bit 0 as busy/ready

name: ICUSSTS2
comment: ICU-S companion status; driver polls low bits with ICUSSTS

name: ICUSCTL
comment: ICU-S control word written during driver reset/abort path
